2. REMOVE FOLLOWING COMPONENTS:
(a) Hood lock brace
(b) Center brace with horn
(c) Washer tank with bracket
(d) Engine under cover (7M-GTE E/G only)
(e) Intercooler (7M-GTE E/G only)
(f) Oilcooler (7M-GTE E/G only)
(g) Condenser fan (7M-GTE E/G and A/T model only)

3. DISCONNECT DISCHARGE HOSE AND SUCTION HOSE

4. DISCONNECT LIQUID TUBE AND SUCTION TUBE
HINT: Cap the open fittings immediately to keep moisture
out of the system.

5. REMOVE CONDENSER
Remove two nuts and two bolts.

INSTALLATION OF CONDENSER

1. INSTALL CONDENSER
(See page AC-8)

2. CONNECT DISCHARGE HOSE AND SUCTION HOSE
Torque:
Discharge hose 250 kg-cm (18 ft-lb, 25 N·m)
Suction hose 325 kg-cm (24 ft-lb, 32 N·m)

3. CONNECT LIQUID TUBE AND SUCTION TUBE
Torque:
Liquid tube 135 kg-cm (10 ft-lb, 13 N·m)
Suction tube 425 kg-cm (24 ft-lb, 32 N·m)

4. INSTALL FOLLOWING COMPONENTS:
(a) Hood lock brace
(b) Center brace with horn
(c) Washer tank with bracket
(d) Engine under cover (7M-GTE E/G only)
(e) Intercooler (7M-GTE E/G only)
(f) Oilcooler (7M-GTE E/G only)
(g) Condenser fan (7M-GTE E/G and A/T model only)

5. IF CONDENSER WAS REPLACED, ADD COMPRESSOR OIL
TO COMPRESSOR
Add 40 — 50 cc (1.4 — 1.7 fl.oz.)
Compressor oil: DENSOIL 6,
SUNISO No.5GS or equivalent

6. EVACUATE AIR FROM AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM

7. CHARGE AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM WITH REFRIGER-
ANT AND CHECK FOR GAS LEAKAGE
Specified amount: 650 — 750 g (1.4 — 1.7 lb)
